meta.source: BiP Intelligence search_notices/get_notice, published 3 to 4 Nov 2026; keyword filter: supported, temporary, community, emergency accommodation, CAS3, leasing
meta.note: Inputs are cautious judgements from notice text; None = unknown. Mack Opco spend search 1 to 4 Nov returned 0 rows.

items.name: Islington Supported Housing and Floating Support Framework (2425-0692)
items.service: Supported housing (Lots 1 to 3) and floating support (Lot 4)
items.route: Competitive flexible procedure, Light Touch; PSQ then tender; framework reopenable
items.why: Tender notice 3 Nov 2026. 8 year flexible framework from est. 1 Oct 2027. £200m incl VAT is the framework CEILING (BiP shows £166.7m ex VAT); no volume committed. Particular suitability: VCSE. Lots 1 to 3 are 24h or transitional supported accommodation; support is psychologically informed and staffed. Requests to participate due 1 Dec 2026 11:59.
items.next: Confirm whether a non-VCSE (Mack Opco) can apply or must partner; decide lots; PSQ by 1 Dec.

items.name: Hampshire: New Supported Accommodation Development Schemes (AS30961, HADSOM mini competition)
items.service: Property provision for adult supported accommodation (council provides support)
items.why: PIN published 3 Nov 2026; contract notice expected 30 Nov 2026. Seeks Registered Providers of Social Housing or Registered Charities to provide property. Mini competition through HADSOM, so only HADSOM members can bid. No value published.
items.next: Check whether Mack or a partner RP is on HADSOM; if not, route is via an RP partner.

items.name: West London Alliance TA Visiting Support Service pilot (TAVSS, C0878)
items.service: Visiting support and occupancy checks in TA (not property)
items.route: Pre-market engagement; contract notice est. 25 Jan 2027
items.why: PME notice 2 Nov 2026. £240k ex VAT est., 1 year pilot 1 Apr 2027 to 31 Mar 2028, 2,000 to 4,000 households. Service only, no property. Engagement deadline 30 Nov 2026 noon via Atamis; group session w/c 16 Nov.
items.next: Decide if Mack offers a support service; if yes, register on Atamis before 30 Nov.

items.name: Westmorland and Furness Domestic Abuse Supported Accommodation (DASA)
items.service: Domestic abuse supported accommodation and support
items.why: Tender notice 3 Nov 2026. £2.34m incl VAT total (BiP £1.95m ex VAT): South Lakeland and Eden £1.06m, Barrow £1.28m. 1 Apr 2027 to 31 Mar 2030, plus up to 3 x 12 months. Quality 90 / cost 10. Enquiries by 19 Nov, tenders by 3 Dec 2026 14:00.
items.next: Check DA specialism needed; likely needs a specialist DA partner.
